## The number

A claim about retrieval quality comes with the run that produced it. If this
changes anything on the read or write path, paste the bench or eval output
before and after (fidelity beside latency, chance beside precision). If it is
not a behaviour change, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] Nothing hardwired about a particular corpus (no label vocabularies, class lists, dataset priors)
- [ ] Comments explain the design decision, not what the line does
- [ ] No em-dashes in user-facing text
